name: Saudi Cable Company
summary: Saudi Cable Company, together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, supplies, and sells copper, aluminium, and fiber optic cable products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Sale of Manufactured Goods and Turnkey Power and Telecommunication Projects. The company offers power cables, including medium and low voltage cables; speciality instrumentation and industrial cables, such as fire retardant and halogen acid gas-free cables; and building and grounding cables comprising bare and insulated copper cables for residential, commercial, and institutional construction projects.
